svg.aria-label: How Openmon works inside: AI agents report each step through hooks; a local server at 127.0.0.1:4747 turns each notice into a signal; the pet picks a pose, earns experience and logs what the agent did; everything shows up in the corner of the screen; and, as your assistant, it answers with your own Claude Code, which can set reminders, keep what it should remember and speak through the bubble. Openmon sends nothing more.
svg.title: How Openmon works inside

g.text: Agents already report what they do (hooks).
A local server turns each notice into a signal.
It picks a pose, earns XP and keeps a log of the work.
Everything shows up in the corner.
And answers as your assistant, with your own Claude Code.
Openmon sends nothing more: the assistant is your Claude Code.
